text: A water pipe has burst on Gandhi Street and clean water has been flowing onto the road since morning.
The main water pipeline near the bus depot is leaking badly and a lot of water is being wasted.
Our house service connection is dripping near the wall and the floor stays damp all day.
The tap water in our house is brown and smells bad, and my children have stomach pain.
Drinking water in our lane looks muddy after the pipe repair.
There is a foul smell in the supply water and I think sewage is mixing with it.
We have not received any water in our street for four days.
The supply timing changed and now only a trickle comes from the tap.
There is no drinking water in our apartment since Monday and the sump is empty.
My water meter has stopped working and shows the same reading for months.
The glass of our water meter is broken and nobody can read it.
The meter at my house runs very fast even when all taps are closed.
The hand pump in our street is broken and the handle is stuck.
The India Mark II pump near the school needs repair, no water comes out.
Sewage is overflowing on our main road and the manhole cover is open.
The underground sewer line on our street is choked and dirty water is spilling onto the road.
The sewer in our whole lane has been blocked for ten days and nobody has come.
The pipe from our toilet to the street sewer is blocked and water is coming back into the bathroom.
Our house drainage connection is clogged and the kitchen sink keeps overflowing.
The sewer pipe under the road has cracked and dirty water is leaking out.
A broken sewer line is leaking under the footpath next to our shop.
The road above the sewer line has collapsed into a hole and children walk past it.
I paid my water tax last month but the portal still shows it as unpaid.
The sewerage charges on my bill are much higher than my neighbours' bills.
I was charged a late payment penalty even though I paid on time.
Please send a water tanker to our street, there has been no supply for a week.
Lorry water has not come to our colony for three days.
I applied for a new water connection two months ago and nothing has happened.
The sewer connection application for our new house has been pending since March.
There is no piped water in our settlement and we need free street water.
Our hamlet has no pipeline and nobody supplies water to us.
Our septic tank is full and needs to be emptied, please send the vehicle.
We need desludging of the septic tank in our compound.
Workers were sent into the manhole without any safety gear or mask.
A man went down inside the septic tank with bare hands to clean it.
I want to complain about the rude behaviour of the staff at the depot office.
Nobody picks up the helpline number and I want to give a suggestion about the service.
